jobs.title: Registered Nurse - AI ChatBot Reviewer (US, Remote)
jobs.description_text: We are seeking experienced US registered nurses to review and assess AI-generated responses from a health coaching agent, with a focus on safety, regulatory compliance, and clinical content accuracy. You will work asynchronously on a dedicated review platform, performing short, structured evaluations to help train and refine AI models for patient-facing health guidance. This is a remote, flexible and short-term project. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: - Structured Grading: Score AI agent responses against a pre-defined rubric, applying the highest-priority criteria consistently across a large volume of items. - Safety Review: Identify responses that could cause patient harm missed red flags, unsafe advice, failure to escalate or signpost to care. - Clinical Accuracy: Assess factual correctness, completeness and guideline alignment of clinical content. - Written Feedback: Provide brief, specific rationale for each failed response and general guidance on how it could be improved. QUALIFICATIONS - Licensure: Active RN license for US - Experience: Minimum 2 years of clinical nursing practice. - Knowledge: Strong grounding in clinical guidelines, patient safety and scope-of-practice boundaries. - Attention to detail: Proven accuracy and consistency in clinical documentation or review work. - Technical proficiency: Comfortable using structured review tools and digital platforms. - Language: Native or near-native written English. LEGAL STATUS - You will have the right to work in your country

jobs.title: Radiologist - Chest CT Annotation - AI Project (USA)
jobs.description_text: We are seeking radiologists with a chest/thoracic background to carry out structural annotation on de-identified chest CT scans, with a focus on spatial accuracy and consistency against detailed annotation guidelines. You will work asynchronously on a dedicated annotation platform, marking points, boxes and measurements on findings that have already been flagged upstream, to support the development of clinical AI imaging models. This is a remote, flexible and short-term project. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: - Click-point placement: Mark specific coordinates on a scan, such as the centre of a nodule. - Bounding boxes: Draw boxes around defined regions of interest, such as a flagged lesion. - Simple measurements: Record diameter, or distance between two marked points, on segmentations or polygons already drawn. - Guideline application: Work to an annotation guideline covering placement conventions, boundary definitions and measurement rules, applied consistently across a large volume of studies. - Edge case handling: Flag ambiguous cases with a short rationale so guidance can be refined. This is structural markup project with no interpretation required. You will not be reading scans for diagnosis, judging malignancy, or making clinical decisions. jobs.title: Drug & Occupational Health Screening Investigator
jobs.description_text:
About Checkr
Checkr is building the data platform to power safe and fair decisions. Over 140,000 companies and millions of people rely on Checkr for AI verification in the moments that matter most: getting a new job, a new place to live, a car ride, childcare, even a date. Customers include Uber, Pennymac, Airbnb, Doordash, and Anthropic.

We’re a team that thrives on solving complex problems with innovative solutions that advance our mission. Checkr is recognized on Forbes Cloud 100 2025 List and is a Y Combinator 2024 Breakthrough Company.

About the team/role

Reporting to Checkr's Associate Manager, Support Operations Escalations, the Drug & Occupational Health Screening Specialist keeps candidate screenings moving by getting ahead of problems before they turn into escalations. You'll own an assigned queue of at-risk reports, run clinic coordination calls, and handle a defined set of direct candidate outreach, using sound judgment to resolve situations that don't fit a standard script. You'll partner closely with Customer Success, Vendor Management, and Product to close individual cases and flag systemic issues, helping close the experience gap our top customers feel most acutely as Checkr scales.

jobs.description_text:
Legend Biotech is a global biotechnology company dedicated to treating and, one day, curing life-threatening diseases. Headquartered in Bridgewater, New Jersey, we are advancing the next generation of cell therapy through a portfolio of innovative technologies, including autologous, allogeneic, and in vivo cell therapy approaches. Our research spans chimeric antigen receptor T-cell (CAR-T), T-cell receptor (TCR-T), natural killer (NK) cell-based therapies, and other emerging platforms designed to transform the treatment of serious diseases. From our global network of research and development sites, we are committed to discovering and developing safe, effective, and cutting-edge therapies for patients worldwide.

Through this strategic partnership, we combine complementary expertise and capabilities to advance innovative immunotherapies for patients living with multiple myeloma.

About MedElite

jobs.description_text:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

ENVIRONMENTAL HEALTH & SAFETY ENGINEER 

The EHS Engineer will support Launch Operations at SpaceX’s launch facility located on Vandenberg Air Force Base. This position is critical as the operation will rely on an EHS subject matter expert to mitigate occupational and compliance risk as they strive to meet an aggressive launch cadence and stretch the capabilities of existing processes to meet their goals. As an EHS Engineer, you will perform hazard assessments, incident investigations, work through employees’ safety concerns and issues, as well as strategize with site leaders to prevent/reduce injuries.
